payload.text: Fisher House To Stay at the FISHER HOUSE CALL 352 548 6492 Holiday Open House Tuesday, December 16th from 11 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. The Busiest Fisher House in the Country! Our policies are listed under the ABOUT TAB above. They include: Code of Ethics, Whistleblower, Non-Discrimination, Conflict of Interest, and Governance of our 990 policies. Donate Our Mission Moving Forward The Gainesville Fisher House Foundation The Fisher House program is a unique private-public partnership that supports America’s military in their time of need. The program recognizes the special sacrifices of our men and women in uniform as well as the hardships of military service by meeting a humanitarian need beyond that normally provided by both the Departments of Defense and the Veterans Administration. A Story of Courage by Catlin Mixson To stay at the Fisher House call 352 548 6492 Support The Fisher House Legacy and Planned Giving You can greatly exemplify the mission of the Gainesville Fisher House Foundation by providing a “home away from home” for veterans, military and their families by considering a financial commitment from your will, living trust, or other estate plans. The financial strengthening provided by bequests, charitable gift annuities and other life-income gifts can give a long-term underpinning to the comfort that will be needed at the Malcom Randall VA Medical Center Fisher House. We appreciate your interest in learning how you may assist the Gainesville Fisher House Foundation as a beneficiary of your long-range plans. If one of these strategies seems right for you, we invite you to contact us to learn more. All information discussed is confidential. Contact A Look Inside The Gainesville Fisher House Take a Virtual Tour Click on the icon and experience the differance you can. Gainesville Fisher House Foundation, Inc MISSION STATEMENT The Gainesville Fisher House Foundation, Inc. is dedicated to supporting the veterans and their families who stay at the Gainesville Fisher House during a medical crisis, surgery or end-of-life condition We do this because “A Family’s Love is Good Medicine.” VISION STATEMENT Providing the assistance to the guests of the Gainesville Fisher in order to provide the comfort and care that is needed during their stay. Our vision is to provide on-going contribution, assistance for the staff and physical facility and an endowment that will accomplish this in perpetuity. The Gainesville Fisher House Foundation P.O.
